title: Verify Nginx Repository Availability
objective: Check if the default Ubuntu repositories contain the required Nginx package version.
rationale: Ubuntu 24.04 includes Nginx in its main repositories; this step confirms availability before attempting installation to avoid unnecessary key additions.
expected_output: Output showing the installed or available version of Nginx and its source repository.
success_criteria: Nginx is listed as a package available in 'main' or 'universe'.
